cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've held your phone up to the rota, so I've held mine up too. Say you support it; I'd like that on record.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was photographing the dates. I said the layout was clear, not that I support those shifts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, a clear record. Tell me which shifts you can endorse and I'll put your name beside them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Send it to me. I'll email the shifts I can actually work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Copy the team, please. Then if someone challenges those shifts, they can see you backed them.
